newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end up sharply, company news helps.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end up sharply, company news helps.

text.p: MADRID, June 18 (Reuter) 1510 GMT - Madrid stocks closed up sharply on Wednesday, bucking the foreign bourse trend, with company news and technical factors fuelling buyers, dealers said. * General index up 5.96 points, 1.04 percent, to 577.80 * Ibex-35 up 75.89 points, 1.16 percent, to 6,619.70 * Telefonica adds 0.94 pct to 4,290 after it said it had settled its dispute with mobile operator Airtel, and after a sharp fall in previous sessions. But volume thinner than usual * Tabacalera ends flat at 7,680 after news it would buy 20 percent of duty-free retailer Aldeasa and shareholders' meeting. * Electricity stocks outpace market after recent weakness.
Volume was less than has been common recently and many attributed gains to arbitrage with futures after some sessions' weakness.
Cofir rose 2.11 percent to 630 after it said it was increasing its stake in NH Hoteles to 100 percent, and the move was well-received by analysts.
Acerinox sank 1.97 percent to 26,900 after saying it did not benefit from dollar strength and ruling out a share split.
